subject: Novum Health pilot — acceptance criteria & onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@novumhealth.io>, Procurement <procurement@novumhealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Novum Health pilot — acceptance criteria & onboarding checklist

Hi Sophie — thanks again for a productive call this morning. High-level recap below and proposed next steps to get the pilot kicked off next week.

Key pain points you shared:
- Clinical notes search is inconsistent across specialties; relevance drops for short queries.
- Current vendor latency spikes during peak hours; impacts clinician workflow.
- Need strict data residency and audit logging for PHI access.

Pilot goals (success = pass/fail):
1) Improvement in top-3 retrieval relevance for clinician queries by +18% (measured on the 200-case prompt set we'll provide).
2) 95th percentile token latency under 350ms for median sequence length (30 tokens) during simulated load at 150 rps.
3) End-to-end audit trail with per-request identifiers and retention >= 90 days.

Scope for the 4-week pilot:
- Dataset: 200 de-identified clinical sample prompts + 20 edge-case prompts from Novum (we'll collect these).
- Features: embeddings + rerank, streaming responses for quick snippets, and prompt templates for triage.
- Access: read-only S3 access to the de-identified repo + temporary service account for test environment.
- Eval: weekly automated run of the prompt set with redwood-evals (scorecard + failure cases).

Owners / contacts:
- Redwood: Alex Martinez (sales/technical lead), Ben Carter (solutions engineer), Marissa Cole (customer success).
- Novum: Sophie Turner (clinical lead), Ilya Petrov (platform/procurement).

Immediate asks from Novum (by EOD Thursday):
1) Confirm the 200-sample data drop (S3 path or secure upload).
2) Provide service account email and preferred cloud region (us-east1 / us-west2).
3) Point person for compliance questionnaire and SOC2 evidence requests.

Deliverables and timeline:
- Day 0–2: Access setup + connectivity test (we send a checklist and access matrix).
- Day 3–7: Ingest + model tuning; initial eval run and baseline report.
- Week 2: Live demo of results + configuration tweaks.
- Week 4: Final evaluation, acceptance review, and recommended next steps (production paths).

Attachments: novum_access_matrix.xlsx (access matrix + minimal IAM), redwood-poc-charter.pdf (scope & metrics).

If that matches your memory, I'll open the HubSpot deal tasks and send the DocuSign for our standard POC SOW so procurement can review.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Sophie / Ilya / Procurement — looping back with a concrete checklist and next steps to avoid confusion. I've attached the access matrix and the POC charter for procurement. Below are the action items we need to close before Day 0 connectivity test.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Novum: Upload 200 de-identified samples to SFTP (Ilya) — Due: 2027-09-17 EOD.
- Novum: Provide Splunk ingest endpoint + test token (Ilya) — Due: 2027-09-17 EOD.
- Novum: Confirm service account email and region (Sophie) — Due: 2027-09-16 12:00 PT.
- Redwood: Share temporary service account + inbound allowlist (Alex) — Due: 2027-09-16 17:00 PT.
- Redwood: Initial eval pipeline and baseline run (Ben) — Due: 2027-09-20.

Prompt set & evaluation details:
- Primary prompt set: 200 clinical queries + 20 edge cases (we will map prompt->expected label).
- Metrics: top-1/top-3 recall, nDCG@5, latency percentiles (p50/p95), and error-class breakdown (null responses, hallucinations).
- Eval cadence: nightly automated runs; weekly summary report every Friday.

Connectivity checklist (Day 0 tests):
- IP allowlist confirmation for Redwood egress (we'll provide list).
- Service account permissions: read-only S3, optional token for Splunk forwarding.
- Test payloads: 10 sample queries for smoke test.

Procurement / SOW notes
- I'll upload a short SOW with line-item pricing to HubSpot now (estimate for 4-week pilot + optional extended support). Ilya / Procurement — if PO is needed instead of card, reply with PO contact and billing address and we'll route finance immediately.

Attachments: novum_access_matrix.xlsx, redwood-poc-charter.pdf

Ben will run the baseline eval once we have the sample data; Marissa will schedule the week-2 demo. If everything looks good, we'll follow your acceptance criteria and produce the final report in Week 4.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Quick notes from the SE side:

- Region confirmed: us-east1 is good. We'll provision test endpoints there.
- Splunk forwarding: we support both HTTP ingest and HEC tokens; Ilya, if you can share the HEC token (or a test token), I'll set up a forwarding rule in staging.

I'll also include an initial set of prompt templates for triage; those are in the redwood-poc-charter.pdf under section 3.
